title: Dead Hang
summary: A passive hang from a bar for grip endurance and time spent at full overhead reach. It builds little muscle.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.5 for forearms (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly forearms total.
Library rating 0.2 for lats: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly lats total.

setup.text: Grip the bar about shoulder width apart.
Let your body hang with your arms straight and shoulders relaxed.

mistakes.text: Bending the arms to hold on.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Shoulders pulled down and back.
Swap sheet: Wrist-extensor focus (back of forearm), Moving reps, Less grip demand.
Swap sheet: Moving reps, Less grip demand.
